prompt: Challenge C115-CH1: Our anti-cheat system flags about 900 accounts a day but our manual review team can only process 200 — legitimate players are getting banned

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Work addresses resampling strategies for rare-event detection in imbalanced datasets, comparing techniques like SMOTE and ADASYN with gradient-boosted trees and evaluating performance through calibration metrics.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06552","field":"abstract","quote":"Credit transaction datasets typically contain fewer than 0.5% positive (fraud) instances, making naive classifier training unreliable"}]},{"text":"Research on threshold selection under class imbalance demonstrates how cost-sensitive criteria and expected utility maximisation can be applied to optimize classifier operating points when misclassification costs are asymmetric.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06553","field":"abstract","quote":"expected utility maximisation is consistently competitive across positive-rate regimes, while F1-optimal thresholds systematically underperform when misclassification costs are asymmetric"}]},{"text":"Work on calibration of probabilistic classifiers shows methods such as isotonic regression and beta calibration improve reliability of probability estimates across imbalanced datasets with positive rates below 1%.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06555","field":"abstract","quote":"Beta calibration consistently reduces ECE across classifiers and positive-rate regimes"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's publications directly address the core technical challenges: handling severe class imbalance (900 flagged vs. legitimate accounts), tuning decision thresholds to reduce false positives without missing true cheaters, and calibrating classifier confidence for explainability to moderators [SYN-PUB-06552, SYN-PUB-06553, SYN-PUB-06555]."}
